description.zh: 回调地址。回调内容请参见以下回调内容示例。
description.en: The callback URL. For more information about the content of the messages that are sent to the callback URL, see the Callback section in this topic.

description.zh:
订阅的频道ID。您可通过调用[ListEventSub](~~2848210~~)接口查询订阅的频道ID。

>- 如果Users.N参数不为空，则此参数必填。
>- ChannelId为*或者不填，表示为全频道订阅，每个AppId只允许1个全频道订阅。
>- 每个AppId最多同时允许创建20个订阅。
description.en:
The channel ID. You can call the [ListEventSub](~~2628135~~) operation to query the channel ID.

>

- This parameter is required if you specify the Users.N parameter.

- If you set this parameter to \* or do not specify this parameter, all channels are subscribed to.

- Each application ID allows only one all-channel subscription.

description.zh:
订阅哪些用户的消息，参数为空表示订阅该房间全部用户（包含主播和观众）。格式如下所示：

```
Users.1=****
Users.2=****
......
```
description.en:
The user whose events you want to subscribe to. If you leave this parameter empty, the events of all users in the channel are subscribed to, including the events of the streamer and viewers. Specify this parameter in the following format:

```
Users.1=****
Users.2=****
......
```

title.zh: 创建订阅房间消息回调

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于创建订阅房间消息的回调。例如：在创建回调时，您可以配置回调地址、事件类型等参数。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to create a callback to subscribe to channel or user events. When you create a callback, you can configure parameters such as the callback URL and event type.

## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 100 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live create-event-sub --app-id 9qb10000 --channel-id 123333 --users user1 --events ChannelEvent --callback-url http://0000.com/callback --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live CreateEventSub --region cn-hangzhou --CallbackUrl 'http://0000.com/callback' --Events.1 ChannelEvent --AppId 9qb10000 --Users.1 user1 --ChannelId 123333
